cc:Work.dc:title: disagreement vs evaluability
cc:Work.dc:description: Each marker is one model. Green circles are evaluable; red crosses failed; 5/6 models are evaluable. Passing the variation screen is not sufficient. A model at x = 1.0 has at least one constant judge, regardless of its ensemble disagreement (y).
